description: MLIT Hydrology and Water Quality Database (水文水質データベース) is a database run by MLIT, River Bureau, Japan. The database gives river water level, discharge, rainfall, dam operation and water quality observations from MLIT-run stations, with annual reports and station lists. Coverage: Japan (national rivers). It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html, text; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("国土交通省 水文水質データベース") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support flood and reservoir operation studies on Japanese rivers. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
